parties.respondent: The Excise And Taxation Officer-Cum-Assessing Authority & Ors.

summary: Jurisdiction over alternative remedy; writ maintainability vs entertainability; suo motu revision under VAT Act s.34; tax rate for mosquito repellent (4% vs 10%); pure question of law exception; High Court erred in dismissing writ without merits examination; Titagarh Paper Mills precedent misapplied; jurisdictional challenge qualifies for exception to alternative remedy rule.
legal_provisions_cited: Haryana Value Added Tax Act, 2003 s.33
Haryana Value Added Tax Act, 2003 s.34
final_judgment: Writ petition should have been entertained on merits; High Court judgment set aside; remand not required as jurisdictional issue established.
